```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)

cog  <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "cog.csv"),
                 col_types = cols(.default = "c"))
filo <- read_csv(here("data", "clean", "filosofi.csv"),
                 col_types = cols(commune = "c"))

communes <- cog |>
  left_join(filo, by = "commune")

glimpse(communes)
nrow(communes)
```
```{r}
communes |>
  summarise(
    n_communes = n(),
    with_median = sum(!is.na(median_living_standard)),
    with_poverty = sum(!is.na(poverty_rate)),
    no_filosofi_row = sum(is.na(median_living_standard) & is.na(poverty_rate))
  )

write_csv(communes, here("data", "clean", "communes.csv"))
```

```{r}

nrow(stations)
```

```{r}
stations <- stations |>
  mutate(latitude = as.numeric(latitude),
         longitude = as.numeric(longitude))

stations |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            no_coords = sum(is.na(latitude) | is.na(longitude)),
            lat_min = min(latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            lat_max = max(latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            lon_min = min(longitude, na.rm = TRUE),
            lon_max = max(longitude, na.rm = TRUE))
```

```{r}
odd <- stations |>
  filter(!is.na(latitude),
         !(latitude > 41 & latitude < 51.5 & longitude > -5.5 & longitude < 10))

nrow(odd)
odd |> count(substr(cp, 1, 2), sort = TRUE) |> print(n = 20)
odd |> slice_head(n = 15)
```

```{r}
stations <- stations |>
  mutate(
    # 1. values divided by 100,000 twice: put the scale back
    tiny = !is.na(latitude) & abs(latitude) < 0.01 & abs(longitude) < 0.01,
    latitude  = if_else(tiny, latitude * 1e5, latitude),
    longitude = if_else(tiny, longitude * 1e5, longitude),
    # 2. latitude and longitude swapped (mainland values only)
    swapped = !is.na(latitude) &
      latitude > -6 & latitude < 11 & longitude > 40 & longitude < 52,
    lat_new = if_else(swapped, longitude, latitude),
    lon_new = if_else(swapped, latitude, longitude),
    latitude = lat_new,
    longitude = lon_new
  ) |>
  select(-lat_new, -lon_new)

stations |> count(tiny, swapped)

odd <- stations |>
  filter(!is.na(latitude),
         !(latitude > 41 & latitude < 51.5 & longitude > -5.5 & longitude < 10))
nrow(odd)
odd |> count(substr(cp, 1, 2), sort = TRUE) |> print(n = 20)
```
```{r}
odd |> select(id, latitude, longitude, cp)
stations |> count(tiny, swapped)
```
```{r}
stations <- stations |>
  mutate(bad = !is.na(latitude) & !(substr(cp, 1, 2) %in% c("97", "98")) &
           !(latitude > 41 & latitude < 51.5 & longitude > -5.5 & longitude < 10),
         latitude  = if_else(bad, NA_real_, latitude),
         longitude = if_else(bad, NA_real_, longitude)) |>
  select(-bad, -tiny, -swapped)

stations |> summarise(no_coords = sum(is.na(latitude)))
```

```{r}
library(sf)

gpkg <- here("data", "raw", "adminexpress-cog-simpl-000-2025.gpkg")
st_layers(gpkg)
```
```{r}
communes_sf <- st_read(gpkg, layer = "commune", quiet = TRUE)

names(communes_sf)
nrow(communes_sf)
```
```{r}
# stations with coordinates become points (WGS 84, same CRS as the gpkg)
st_pts <- stations |>
  filter(!is.na(latitude)) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326, remove = FALSE)

st_pts <- st_join(st_pts,
                  communes_sf |> select(insee_com),
                  join = st_within)

st_pts |> st_drop_geometry() |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            matched = sum(!is.na(insee_com)),
            unmatched = sum(is.na(insee_com)))
```

```{r}
st_pts |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  filter(is.na(insee_com)) |>
  select(id, latitude, longitude, cp)
```
```{r}
unm <- st_pts |> filter(is.na(insee_com))

idx <- st_nearest_feature(unm, communes_sf)
unm$insee_nearest <- communes_sf$insee_com[idx]
unm$dist_m <- as.numeric(st_distance(unm, communes_sf[idx, ], by_element = TRUE))

unm |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(id, cp, insee_nearest, dist_m)
```
```{r}
# commune code: polygon match, or nearest commune for the 16 coastal ones
station_commune <- st_pts |>
  st_drop_geometry() |>
  select(id, insee_com) |>
  left_join(unm |> st_drop_geometry() |> select(id, insee_nearest), by = "id") |>
  mutate(commune = coalesce(insee_com, insee_nearest)) |>
  select(id, commune)

stations_full <- stations |>
  left_join(station_commune, by = "id") |>
  left_join(communes |> select(commune, median_living_standard, poverty_rate),
            by = "commune")

stations_full |>
  summarise(n = n(),
            with_commune = sum(!is.na(commune)),
            with_median = sum(!is.na(median_living_standard)))

write_csv(stations_full, here("data", "clean", "stations_communes.csv"))
```
```{r}
stations_full |>
  filter(!is.na(commune), is.na(median_living_standard)) |>
  count(dept = substr(commune, 1, 3), sort = TRUE)
```
